notes.title: Important Bugfix!
notes.content:
We got reports of a bug in the save system that would cause all the progress in the current objectives to reset when a level is loaded.
Not all levels present this error, but in the ones that do (like Tarqeq), the bug can be really annoying.

Thanks to everyone who reported it!
We keep working to ensure SOOT is in the best state possible!

- The Ceiba Team

notes.title: NEW GAME MODE AND ADDITIONAL LANGUAGE
notes.content:
[u][b]UPDATE DETAILS[/b][/u]

1.- Immerse yourself in a new game mode "Settler Mode" where you will command the fleet in the terraforming of a planet.
Manage resources and defend yourself from attacks by pirates and enemy forces.
 
2.- German language incorporated in the game.

notes.title: Version: 1.30
notes.content:
This version includes several bug fixes and some localization improvements.
[list]
[*] Bug: The game does not properly save Shipped H2O - [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Bug: If the game is in a comic book section and the window is minimized, the music starts playing double - [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Localization Error: Level 3 - Ophion won't load properly in Spanish - [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Localization Error: Level 6 - Tarqeq won't load properly in Spanish - [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Localization Error: Saved Game message won't translate to Spanish - [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Localization Error: Asteroid Attractor messages won't translate properly to Spanish - [b]FIXED[/b]
[/list]
